DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、あの噂聞いた？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 何の噂？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 女子生徒のスカートを覗こうとするヘンタイが出没してる、って噂があって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まったく、嘆かわしい世の中だ

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: それは大変だね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生も、もし怪しいヘンタイを見かけたら、すぐ風紀委員会に連絡して

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 分かった、任せて

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生最近、ゲヘナによく出張に来てるみたいだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: このところ、ゲヘナ学園に関する仕事が多くって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: イオリちゃんに会いたくって、つい……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……そうなんだ。お疲れ様

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……は？何を言ってるんだ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: でも実際、学園ではあまり会わないな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 出張に来る時は、どこにいるんだ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 校庭とか

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……校庭？何のために？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 今度会った時に教えてあげるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: なんか、怪しいな……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 報告だと最近、ブラックマーケットで密輸品の取引量が増えてるらしい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 生活に必要なものなら、普通のマーケットで何でも手に入るのに……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いったいブラックマーケットで、どんな取引が行われてるんだ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私は知らないなあ、興味も無いし……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: それはそうだろうな

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 普通の人がブラックマーケットに足を踏み入れることなんてそうそう無い

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生も、ブラックマーケットの悪党たちとは関わらないよう気を付けて

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、肝に銘じるね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ……先生、本当に私の卒業アルバムを変なことに使ったりしないだろうな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生を信じて渡したんだから……他の人に見せたりするなよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: ……ねえ、イオリ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ん？なに？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 小学生の時のイオリも可愛い

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うるさい！死ね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今日の風紀委員会の活動では世話になった、ありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私の方こそありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: イオリはもちろん、ゲヘナの風紀委員にも色々助けてもらったから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は私たちと違って、銃で撃たれたら本当に危ないんだから

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ああいう危険な任務なら、私たちが一緒に行くのは当たり前

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、ありがとね。そういえばイオリ、

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: さっき作戦中に背中を怪我してなかった？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ああ……そういえばそうだった

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 気にしないで、大した怪我じゃない

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、このメッセージを見たら、ゲヘナ正門前の住宅街3丁目に……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちょっと……アクシデントがあって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: アクシデントって、どんな？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いいから、早く来て！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あと！他の生徒たちには、絶対に私がここにいるって言うなよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: さっき送られてきてたこの写真、何でまだ持ってるんだ！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: よく撮れてるから、もしかしたら欲しいかなって

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 可愛くない？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: そういう問題じゃない！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 消してって言ったじゃん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 何でまだ持ってるんだ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 消して！今すぐ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 聞いてる！？ちょっと！！

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 듣자 하니 최근 외진 골목길에서 여학생들의 치마 속을 훔쳐보려는 변태가 출몰한다나 봐.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님도 혹시 수상한 변태를 보거든 게헨나 선도부에 바로 연락해줘.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 최근 게헨나 학원으로 자주 출장을 오던 것 같던데……

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 최근 게헨나 학원과 관련된 업무가 많아져서.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 이오리 쨩을 자주 보고 싶은 마음에 그만…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그나저나 정작 학원에서는 선생님과 마주친 일이 거의 없네.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 출장을 오면 주로 어디서 시간을 보내는 거야?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 최근 첩보 멤버의 보고에 따르면 블랙마켓의 밀수품 거래량이 늘어난 것 같아.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 생활에 필요한 물건이라면 일반 마켓에서도 다 구할 수 있는데…

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 도대체 블랙마켓에서는 어떤 물건을 거래하는 거지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 평범한 사람이라면 블랙마켓에 발을 들일 일도 없을 테니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 가급적 선생님도 블랙마켓의 악당들과는 엮이지 않게 조심하라고.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 정말로 내 졸업 앨범을 이상한 일에 쓰려는 게 아니지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님을 믿고 맡긴 거니까…… 다른 사람에게 보여주거나 하면 안 돼!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 선도부 활동에서는 꽤나 신세를 졌네. 고마워.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 게헨나 선도부에게 큰 도움을 받았어. 고마워.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님은 학생들과는 달리 총에 맞으면 정말로 위험할 수도 있으니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 총을 사용하는 위험한 임무에는 우리가 함께하는 게 당연하지.

DialogKR.Speaker: Player
DialogKR.Text: 아까 작전 중에 등을 다치지 않았어?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 신경 쓰지 마. 대수롭지 않은 생채기일 뿐이니까.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님, 이 문자를 보면 게헨나 정문 앞의 3거리 주택가로 와줘……

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아무튼 묻지는 말고 빨리 와 줘!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그리고 다른 학생들에게는 내가 여기 있다는 걸 절대 알리지 마!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 방금 메일로 보낸 이 사진은 뭐야?!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 아까 분명히 사진은 지우라고 했잖아!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내 말 듣고 있는 거야? 빨리 지우라고!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, did you hear the rumor?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What rumor?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: From what I've heard, there's a pervert hanging around the alleys, trying to flip skirts.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ugh, what an ugly world.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's terrible...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If you see someone suspicious, please contact the Gehenna Prefect Team right away.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Okay, got it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, you've been coming to Gehenna Academy a lot these days...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Well, I've had a lot of work to do at Gehenna lately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I can't help wanting to see you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I see... You're working hard.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: HUH?! What are you talking about?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: In any case, I almost never run into you at the academy.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Where do you spend most of your time when you come here?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: At the campus.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: The campus? What's at the campus?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll tell you in person.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You're being awfully suspicious...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: According to a recent report from intelligence, the volume of contraband on the Black Market seems to have increased.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You can get everything you need for your daily life at the regular market...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So what's being traded on the Black Market?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm not really interested, so I don't know much about it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I can see that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: A normal person has no reason to even consider the Black Market.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Try not to get involved with those Black Market scoundrels, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll keep that in mind.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you sure you're not gonna use my yearbook for anything weird?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I trust you with it...but don't show it to anyone else!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Iori.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: H-Huh? What is it?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You were cute in elementary school too.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Shut up! I'll kill you!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You helped me a lot today. Thank you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'm the one who should be saying that.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: The Prefect Team is always helping me. Thank you.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's particularly dangerous for you if you get shot, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It only makes sense for us to join you on a dangerous mission when guns are involved.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: But didn't you

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: get hurt during the mission?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Oh... You mean the wound on my back?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't worry. It's just a scratch.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, when you see this text, please come to the District 3 residential area by Gehenna's main gate.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: There's...a bit of a problem.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: What's the matter?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Don't ask! Just get over here!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: And don't tell the other students that I'm here!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What's with the photo you just sent to my email?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's a good shot, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: It's cute!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: What do you mean it's a good shot?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's not cute at all!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I told you to delete that photo!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Why do you still have it?!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Delete it! Now!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Are you listening to me? Delete it right now!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ได้ยินข่าวลือนั้นหรือยัง?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ข่าวลืออะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็ช่วงนี้น่ะสิ มีโรคจิตที่พยายามแอบดูใต้
กระโปรงนักเรียนหญิงตามถนนซอยเปลี่ยว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: โลกนี้ชักอยู่ยากขึ้นแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: นั่นมันเรื่องใหญ่เลยนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าคุณครูเห็นโรคจิตน่าสงสัยละก็
มาแจ้งคณะกรรมการวินัยของ
เกเฮนน่าทันทีเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ได้เลย ไม่ต้องห่วง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
หมู่นี้คุณครูมาทำงานที่สถาบันเกเฮนน่า
บ่อยจังเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วงนี้งานเกี่ยวกับสถาบันเกเฮนน่า
มีเยอะขึ้นน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
มาบ่อยเพราะครูอยากเจออิโอริจัง
ยังไงล่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แบบนี้นี่เอง... เหนื่อยน่าดูเลยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม? พูดอะไรของคุณครูน่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จะว่าไป ไม่ค่อยได้เจอคุณครูในสถาบัน
เท่าไหร่เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ปกติมาทำงานแล้วจะไปอยู่ที่ไหนเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อยู่ในสนามน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ...สนาม? ที่นั่นมีอะไรให้ทำงั้นเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะบอกตอนที่เจอกันคราวหน้านะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: น่าสงสัยแฮะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ล่าสุดหน่วยข่าวกรองเพิ่งรายงานมาว่ามี
การค้าสินค้าหนีภาษีในตลาดมืดเยอะขึ้น
กว่าเดิม

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเป็นของกินของใช้ทั่วไป ไปซื้อเอาใน
ตลาดธรรมดาก็น่าจะได้นี่นา...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ในตลาดมืดค้าขายสินค้าแบบไหนกันนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ไม่รู้สิ ครูไม่ค่อยสนใจเรื่องนี้เท่าไหร่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก็คงเป็นแบบนั้น

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คนทั่วไปไม่มีทางเหยียบเข้าไปในตลาด
มืดอยู่แล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูก็ระวังตัวด้วยล่ะ อย่าไปมีเรื่อง
ข้องเกี่ยวกับคนไม่ดีในตลาดมืด

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูจะระวังตัว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ได้จะเอาอัลบั้มจบการศึกษาของฉันไป
ใช้ในทางที่ไม่ดีใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่ฉันเชื่อใจคุณครูนะ... อย่าเอาไปให้คน
อื่นดูล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อิโอริ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม? มีอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อิโอริสมัยเป็นเด็กประถมก็น่ารักดีนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หนวกหูน่า! หยุดพูดเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
วันนี้คุณครูช่วยฉันในงานของคณะกรรม
การวินัยได้เยอะเลย ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูต่างหากที่ต้องขอบใจ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text:
สมาชิกคนอื่นในคณะกรรมการวินัย
ก็ช่วยครูเหมือนกัน ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครูไม่ได้เก่งกาจเหมือนนักเรียนคนอื่น
นะ หากโดนยิงขึ้นมาก็เป็นเรื่องแน่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ภารกิจเสี่ยงอันตรายที่ต้องใช้ปืนน่ะ
ฝากให้พวกเราดีกว่า

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แต่อิโอริก็...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เมื่อกี้เธอบาดเจ็บที่หลังมาไม่ใช่เหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: อ่า... หมายถึงแผลที่หลังใช่มั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่ต้องห่วงหรอก แค่รอยถลอกนิดหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ถ้าเห็นข้อความนี้ช่วยมาที่
บล็อกที่ 3 จากประตูใหญ่ของเกเฮนน่าที...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอดีว่า... ฉันเจอปัญหานิดหน่อยน่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ปัญหาอะไรเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เดี๋ยวค่อยถามน่า รีบๆ มาหาก่อน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วก็ห้ามบอกนักเรียนคนอื่นล่ะว่าฉันอยู่ที่นี่

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู!!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: รูปพวกนี้ที่ส่งมาทางอีเมลมันคืออะไรน่ะ?!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูถ่ายเก่งใช่มั้ยล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถ่ายออกมาน่ารักดีนะว่ามั้ย?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ่ายเก่งเกิ่งอะไรกันล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่มีส่วนไหนน่ารักซะหน่อย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ฉันบอกไปแล้วไม่ใช่เหรอว่าให้ลบรูป!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วทำไมถึงยังมีเก็บไว้อีกล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ลบเดี๋ยวนี้เลยนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฟังที่ฉันพูดอยู่หรือเปล่า? บอกให้รีบๆ
ลบยังไงล่ะ!

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，你聽說那個傳聞了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有偷窺女學生裙底的變態出沒的傳聞

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師如果看見了可疑的變態，請立即聯絡風紀委員會

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師最近好像經常來格黑娜出差……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 最近有很多格黑娜學園的工作

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 因為想和伊織醬見面，忍不住就……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 但實際上，我們很少在學校內見到面呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師來出差的時候都待在哪裡？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 報告顯示，近期黑市走私品的交易量增加中

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果是生活必需品，普通市場就都能買到了……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 到底都在黑市進行什麼樣的交易呢？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 普通人是不會踏入黑市的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師也要注意不要和黑市的惡黨們扯上關係

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: ……老師，真的不會把我的畢業紀念冊用在奇怪的事情上吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我是相信老師才交給你的……不要給別人看喔！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 小學時期的伊織也很可愛呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 今天謝謝老師協助風紀委員會的活動

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不只是伊織，還得到了其他格黑娜風紀委員的各種幫助

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師和我們不一樣，中彈的話就危險了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 如果是這麼危險的任務，我們一起去是理所當然的

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 伊織在剛才的作戰中背部受傷了嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊啊……這麼說來確實是呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 別放在心上，不是什麼嚴重的傷

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，看到這個訊息的時候，請來格黑娜正門前的住宅街3丁目……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 還有！絕對不能告訴其他學生我在這裡！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 剛才發來的照片為什麼還留著！！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 因為拍得不錯，想說你可能會想要
